title: PokeNet
description: Welcome to PokeNet! A Cobblemon survival server featuring a vast open world, custom quests, and rare Pokémon. A balanced experience designed for adventurers and trainers alike.
body:
# 🌍⚡ Welcome to PokeNet ⚡🌍

### *Explore. Survive. Catch. Thrive.*

**PokeNet** is a complete Cobblemon Survival & Exploration server where freedom and adventure come together. Explore a massive open world, survive in challenging environments, and catch Pokémon as you progress through the game.

This modpack is **required** to play on the server, ensuring you have the best visual experience, custom items, and performance optimizations.

---

## 🎮 Server Information

| **Server IP** | **Status** |
| :--- | :--- |
| `join.pokenet.net` | ✅ Online |

> **⚠️ Note:** Make sure to allocate at least **4GB of RAM** to your launcher for the best experience.

---

## ✨ What PokeNet Offers

* **🧭 Custom Quests:** A unique storyline designed to guide your journey and reward your progression.
* **🌲 True Survival:** Classic Minecraft gameplay with resource gathering, building, and land claiming.
* **🔎 Exploration-Based:** A world full of discoveries, structures, and hidden secrets.
* **🤝 Active Community:** Regular events, tournaments, and a friendly atmosphere awaits.

---

## 🔗 Join the Community

Don't play alone! Join our Discord to find trade partners, get support, and see the latest updates.

[**Join Our Discord**](https://discord.gg/PMXRNwtV)

---

*Whether you enjoy exploring, building, or becoming the ultimate trainer, PokeNet delivers a balanced and immersive Cobblemon experience.*
